features.name: Set up approval rules
features.summary: Admins set up departments, categories and approval rules, so every request follows the right route automatically.

flows.title: Set up departments, categories and rules

usecases: Set up approval rules by amount and category
questions: If two rules match, which one wins?
unconfirmed: The system checks for clashing rules

board.title: Setup: departments, categories and approval rules

issues.title: Set up departments and approvers
issues.req: Admins add departments and choose each department's approver.
done: Each department has at least one approver
Approvers can be changed later

issues.title: Set up request categories
issues.req: Admins create categories (IT equipment, Software, Services) with a few fields each.
done: Categories can be added, renamed and switched off
Each category can have its own fields

issues.title: Set up approval rules by amount
issues.req: Requests above an amount need an extra approver (for example, over 5,000 needs Finance).
done: Rules by amount and category
The route is shown before a request is submitted
issues.comments: Head of Procurement approved showing the route before submit

features.name: Create a purchase request
features.summary: Employees raise a request to buy something, from a catalog item or a custom item, and send it for approval.
usecases: Request a catalog item: pick a ready-made item, and most fields fill in.
Request something custom: describe an item that isn't in the catalog.
Attach a vendor quote: upload it, and the amount is read from it.
questions: Which file types are accepted for quotes?
Can a catalog item's price be changed?
unconfirmed: Requests can be saved as drafts

issues.title: Start a new request
issues.req: A clear “New request” button lets the requester choose a catalog item or a custom item.
done: “New request” visible on every page
Catalog items pre-fill fields
issues.comments: Sales asked for the button in the top bar too

issues.title: Fill in request details
issues.req: The requester fills item, quantity, cost, needed-by date and a reason.
done: Required fields are marked
Missing fields are shown before submitting

issues.title: Attach a vendor quote
issues.req: The requester can upload a quote; the amount is read from it.
done: PDF and images accepted
Amount from the quote can be corrected
issues.comments: Open: which file types are accepted for quotes?

issues.title: Submit for approval
issues.req: The requester sees the approval route and submits.
done: Route shown before submit
Approvers are notified
issues.comments: Finance wants to see the route on the confirmation screen

features.name: Track purchase requests
features.summary: Everyone can find a request and see its status, approval route and history.

flows.title: Find a request and see its details

usecases: Find a request: search and filter the list by status, category or date.
See request details: status, approval route, history and comments.
questions: Should requesters see other people's requests?
unconfirmed: When nothing is found, the page shows tips to change the search

issues.title: Request list with search and filters
issues.req: A list of requests with search and filters by status, category and date.
done: Search by item or request number
Status tabs: Draft, Waiting, Approved, Rejected
issues.comments: Open: should requesters see other people's requests?

issues.title: Request details and history
issues.req: A details page shows status, approval route, history and comments.
done: Current approver shown
Full history of changes and decisions

features.name: Approve purchase requests
features.summary: Approvers decide on requests in one place: approve, reject with a reason, ask for changes or delegate.

flows.title: Approve, reject or ask for changes

usecases: Approve or reject: decide, giving a reason when rejecting.
Ask for changes: send it back, and the requester edits and resubmits.
Delegate: hand the decision to a colleague while away.
questions: Do approvers decide one after another, or at the same time?
unconfirmed: Finance approves after the first approver

issues.title: Approve or reject a request
issues.req: Approvers approve, or reject with a reason.
done: A reason is required to reject
Requester is notified
issues.comments: Legal: rejection reason must be required

issues.title: Ask for changes and resubmit
issues.req: Approvers can send a request back; the requester edits and resubmits.
done: Comments shown to the requester
Resubmitted request keeps its history

issues.title: Delegate approval
issues.req: Approvers can hand decisions to a colleague while away.
done: Delegation has start and end dates
Both people can see delegated requests
issues.comments: Open: can a delegated approver delegate again?
